# Sales Operations & Deal Desk Associate

Job Posted 26 Days AgoPosted 26 Days Ago

New York, NY, USA

In-Office

70K-100K Annually

Entry level

Artificial Intelligence • Machine Learning • Software

The Role

Supports sales execution and GTM operations through CRM administration, sales reporting, performance analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination. Manages deal desk activities by reviewing pricing, discounts, contract terms, commercial structures, and approval requirements. Ensures transactions comply with company policies and approval frameworks while serving as an escalation point for complex or high-value deals.

Summary Generated by Built In

**Description**

This is a fantastic opportunity to join Luminance, the pioneer of Legal-Grade™ AI for enterprise. Backed by internationally renowned VCs and named in both the Forbes AI 50 list of ‘Most Promising Private AI Companies in the World’ and Inc. 5000’s ‘Fastest Growing Companies in America’, Luminance is disrupting the legal profession around the globe.

We are seeking a Sales Operations & Deal Desk Associate who will drive operational excellence across our go-to-market (GTM) teams as part of our Sales Operations function and also be responsible for supporting revenue growth by ensuring deals are structured, priced, and approved in alignment with mandated company policies and commercial strategy. This role acts as a key control point between GTM, Finance, Legal and Leadership, balancing speed with governance.

**Responsibilities**

·       Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team, ensuring smooth sales execution.

·       Assist in the creation of sales reporting and performance analysis to monitor sales activities and outcomes.

·       Assist in maintaining and managing the CRM system, ensuring proper usage, data input, and reporting.

·       Support the identification and implementation of process improvements to enhance the efficiency of the sales function.

·       Work closely with marketing, finance, and customer service teams to ensure alignment on sales efforts and initiatives.

·       Review and approve non-standard deals, including pricing, discounting, contract terms, and commercial structures.

·       Ensure all deals comply with internal policies, commercial structures and approval frameworks.

·       Act as the escalation point and management proxy for complex or high-value transactions.

·       Monitor and enforce approval matrices and delegation of authority.

**Requirements**

·       Motivated self-starter who is ready to make a real impact in a fast-growing company.

·       Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.

·       Familiarity with SaaS business models, software licensing, and commercial terms.

·       Strong attention to detail with excellent communication, administrational and time management skills.

·       Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

·       Proficiency with CRM tools e.g. HubSpot preferred.

**Benefits**

- Competitive salary and quarterly bonus structure.
- New York office location and opportunity for international business travel.
- 401k with 4% matching contribution: Invest in your future from the start.
- Health Insurance from Day 1 of employment:

  - Choice of PPO or HDHP plan available. 100% of individual premiums covered by Luminance for both plans, and 75% coverage of premiums for dependents.

- Enhanced maternity and paternity policies: To support working parents.
- Learning and development budget per employee to empower our team members to elevate their potential.
- Paid sabbatical opportunities.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity policies – to support working parents.
- Annual learning and development budget of $2750 per employee to empower our team members to elevate their potential.

Salary: $70,000 - $100,000 base salary per annum depending on experience.

Bonus: Discretionary performance-based bonus paid out Quarterly.

## What We Do

Built on a proprietary legal Large Language Model (LLM), Luminance’s specialised legal co-pilot uses next-generation to automate the generation, negotiation and analysis of contracts. Developed by world-leading AI experts from the University of Cambridge, validated by leading lawyers, and in use by over 500 customers in 60 countries, Luminance’s specialist ‘legal-grade’ AI is a key component of any legal team. Luminance brings AI to every touchpoint a lawyer has with their contracts. As the first AI in the world capable of taking a first pass review of any contract under negotiation, Luminance instantly highlights areas of risk so legal teams can focus time where it’s needed. With a first-of-its-kind AI chatbot, Luminance also allows businesses to find a comfortable middle ground during negotiations and draft new, acceptable clause wording in just a few clicks. An intelligent contract repository and powerful legal process automation tools deliver maximum insight across any organisation’s contractual landscape, ensuring legal teams can respond to queries with clarity and speed. Luminance is the proud recipient of several prestigious accolades including the Queen’s Award for Innovation and the CogX 2023 Award for Best Product – Legal, and has been named to Tech Nation’s 'Future Fifty', CNBC’s ‘Upstart 100’ list and as a Technology Pioneer by the World Economic Forum.
